name: fix158_generic_talk
verifies: fix-158: generic NPCs (no infos of their own) get the hero's generic infos (G3 gCInfoManager_PS::HasInfos falls back to the PC_Hero list): the Vangard trader RebTrader_01 is talkable and offers the trade topic FILLER27, the trade page opens; a generic mercenary in Faring with nothing to say answers with a StartSayRefuseTalk line and no dialog opens
notes: Merc_06#7d0c9592 stands ~14 m from the dev start (sector Faring_NPC_01, on at the start) and owns no info; the first refusal is the situational variant (FUN_10051a30: by his routine destination, default WhatDoYouWant). RebTrader_01#e8bf511f is in sector Vangard_NPC_01 (on at the start), tradesAtStart. RebTrader_02#b3073412 (Faring_NPC_02, off until the liberation) is covered by GenericTalkTests.RebTrader_OffersTrade_WhenHisSectorIsOn. Before fix-158 Dialog.CanTalkTo counted only own topics, so no generic NPC could be talked to.
